name: Logitech Gaming Mouse G502
notes: 67-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech Gaming Mouse G502, from a dump of the device: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/-/project/147/uploads/48b0b38054f3deae92e639411f39d91e/recording-1.29.2-working.yaml. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
